svg.title: Transcytosis and release at neutral surface
svg.desc: FcRn binds Fc in acidic compartments and releases IgG at near-neutral pH. Schematic cellular transport; FcRn also participates in systemic IgG recycling. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
